principle: Do not imply a backend capability that the current public wire contract does not provide.

capabilities.backend: GET /api/v2/locations with cursor, filters, bbox/radius, and bounded limit
capabilities.frontend: Map viewport results, database result table, loading/partial-page context

capabilities.backend: Current public contract is facility/location-shaped plus graph facility/organization summaries; public record envelope for evidence, event, source-record, and community types must be extended before those types are first-class public pages
capabilities.frontend: One shared detail, URL, provenance, graph-node, and SEO composition is the target architecture; initial production scope must gate unsupported record families and use existing facility APIs only

capabilities.backend: GET /api/v2/locations/{facility_id} exists; canonical /api/v2/records/{record_id}, organization detail, and non-facility record DTOs are future contract work
capabilities.frontend: Stable canonical facility page now; organization graph summaries are selectable but do not gain fake detail pages; evidence/event/source-record pages wait for their public DTOs

capabilities.backend: GET /api/v2/discovery/filters and /api/v2/discovery/facets
capabilities.frontend: Progressive filter controls, counts with release scope

capabilities.backend: Current q search is over released facility/location fields; all-record global search needs a record-index contract as non-facility records become public
capabilities.frontend: Global search is the intended product semantics; initial implementation must label its supported facility/location scope until the record-index contract exists; viewport queries remain separate

capabilities.backend: GET /api/v2/releases/manifest and response meta
capabilities.frontend: Persistent release/profile/scope notice and share-state pinning; display CalVer plus stable release identity when present

capabilities.backend: Implemented manifest exposes release_id and manifest_sha256; recommended display convention is CalVer YYYY.MM.N plus title, with release_id and checksum kept separate; API/software SemVer remains separate
capabilities.frontend: Human-readable release context, stable machine identity, and current suppression/revocation gates even for older release references

capabilities.backend: GET /api/v2/locations.csv, bounded rows and profile notice
capabilities.frontend: Explicit selected-release export with visible scope and limitation

capabilities.backend: display_precision exact|city|unmapped with nullable coordinates
capabilities.frontend: Distinct exact pin versus city/coarse area/halo symbols; no routing for city/unmapped

capabilities.backend: Projection fields for lifecycle, origin, source, URL, retrieval, release
capabilities.frontend: Evidence panel and filterable status; never rewrite source wording

capabilities.backend: GET /api/v2/graph/connections, /api/v2/graph/entities, and GET /api/v2/graph/entities/{entity_id}/neighborhood; release/profile/suppression/privacy gated read-only projection over private source-qualified evidence
capabilities.frontend: Public connections on eligible released facility/organization graph summaries and facility detail; private routes remain unavailable

capabilities.backend: Public edge DTO carries connection_edge_id, connection_type, confidence, confidence_band, match_method, signals, contradictions, provenance, source_references, ruleset, observed/computed dates, conflicting, and persistent disclaimer
capabilities.frontend: Exact/high/medium/low presentation with ruleset-estimate language, explicit disclaimer, and selectable edge explanation; map to internal view-model aliases explicitly

capabilities.backend: Implemented one-hop neighborhood payload is bounded to 100/page and entities are facility/organization summaries without canonical URLs; richer record-node metadata and non-facility DTOs remain future contract work
capabilities.frontend: Selectable max-50-node/max-100-edge canvas paired with accessible edge list; facility node may resolve to current location detail; organization node remains a summary until a public route exists

capabilities.backend: Private neighborhood traversal exists; no public arbitrary multi-hop traversal contract is frozen
capabilities.frontend: MVP supports bounded one-hop public visualization; multi-hop is later

capabilities.backend: q over canonical name, city, country, category, source name per current facility/location filters contract
capabilities.frontend: Debounced query with cancellable requests; initial UI must disclose supported scope until all-record search exists; no client-wide filtering

capabilities.backend: Categories are exposed; animal/activity detail depends on projection fields and source contract
capabilities.frontend: Keep V1 OR search intent and category labels where mapped; show unsupported fields as unavailable, not guessed

capabilities.backend: No UEC-owned imagery service; choose a licensed documented MapLibre-compatible raster provider, or evaluate Mapbox Standard Satellite only with its compatible Mapbox GL JS v3/SDK v11 renderer and provider terms
capabilities.frontend: Major selectable basemap with disclosure and code-split loading; satellite does not change precision semantics

capabilities.backend: Optional Google Street View/provider integration; availability, key, cost, terms, and privacy review required
capabilities.frontend: Optional outbound/provider view for eligible exact public points only

capabilities.backend: Provider-dependent, e.g. Esri Wayback where coverage and terms permit; no global availability guarantee
capabilities.frontend: Date/provider-labelled comparison; never treated as proof of historical operation

capabilities.backend: Needs explicit density/layer query semantics and exact/coarse denominators
capabilities.frontend: Later separate-stratum heatmap and alternate layers; not MVP default

capabilities.backend: No new backend required if bounded tile contract is sufficient; requires scale/accessibility evaluation
capabilities.frontend: Later MapLibre globe/3D orientation view; never replaces list or precision labels

capabilities.backend: Stable facility identifiers exist; record-wide canonical metadata/sitemap contract is future work
capabilities.frontend: Canonical URL, metadata, JSON-LD, and release-aware sitemap for eligible records without completeness claims

capabilities.backend: History exists privately but no public history endpoint is frozen
capabilities.frontend: Show first/last observed and count now; history timeline later

capabilities.backend: Current location DTO lacks evidence hashes and geocoder metadata
capabilities.frontend: Show available source URL/date; do not invent hashes

capabilities.backend: Profiles include official, secondary, community; each response carries profile and warning semantics; isolated intake/promotion workflow remains future
capabilities.frontend: Never mix profiles; community/unreviewed context must precede access and persist on rows, map, detail, graph, sitemap, and export

capabilities.backend: Needs isolated untrusted submission store, moderation, provenance, privacy, abuse controls, and explicit release promotion
capabilities.frontend: Future submission/tip/correction UI; never automatic publication or merge

capabilities.backend: No backend need
capabilities.frontend: Optional future enhancement only with explicit consent; never persist or place in shared URLs/analytics

capabilities.backend: Graph edges are evidence relationships, not universal identity
capabilities.frontend: Never render inferred edge as merged node, ownership fact, or supply-chain proof

capabilities.backend: Separate /api/dev/preview and private graph routes require local authorization
capabilities.frontend: Development-only flag and unmistakable private/not-published banner; never bundled in production
